sentence: This project uses whole genome sequencing to find genetic causes of male infertility and builds a shared online space for interpreting genes and variants.
This project studies how connexin 43 gap junction coupling in the trigeminal ganglia contributes to chronic temporomandibular joint pain.
This project builds tools that compare the structure of glycoproteins from different biological samples during disease.
This project supports research on cancers caused by viruses, which occur more often in people living with HIV.
This project tests an injectable therapy that tries to regrow salivary glands and restore saliva in cancer patients with dry mouth after radiation.
This project tries to find out how proteins called glutamate transporters interact with ions to control glutamate in the brain.
This project studies how microRNAs affect alveolar type 1 and alveolar type 2 cells and interstitial lung disease.
This project builds a breast cancer therapy that delivers protein cytokines to the primary tumor and across the blood-brain barrier to secondary tumors.
This project tries to find out why chemotherapy harms the heart differently by sex in mouse and human hearts.
This project tests whether a small molecule that targets DNA repair proteins can reduce deaths and long-term harm in animals exposed to lethal radiation.
This project builds tools to edit genes in skeletal muscle, control gene editing enzymes and combine these parts in a single gene therapy vector.
This project tests whether blocking an inflammatory enzyme protects donor livers from injury during liver transplantation.
This project builds and shares imaging tools, such as confocal microscopy and adaptive optics, for watching changes in the visual system.
This project studies which genes an understudied microRNA targets and how those genes relate to epigenetic changes in a human neuronal cell line.
This project tries to find out where a membrane lipid binds voltage-gated potassium channels and how this affects their function and movement in axons.
This project studies how adolescent binge drinking changes behavior and brain signaling differently by sex, including a specific population of neurons.
This project uses high-resolution imaging to study how patterns of peptides on antigen-presenting cells control the activity of T cells.
This project builds a theory of how neural circuits carry out computations that support cognitive processes.
This project studies the molecular, cellular and developmental steps that form the uterus and remove female reproductive tract tissues during male development.
